_format: Hand-curated Macaulay Library photos, keyed by eBird species code.
These override the Wikimedia/iNaturalist lookup for that species.
To add one: open macaulaylibrary.org, search the species, pick a photo,
then take the asset ID from its URL (macaulaylibrary.org/asset/<id>) and
the photographer's name from the caption. Restart the server to pick up
changes. Species codes are the eBird codes shown in /api/birds responses
A bare "speciesCode": "303341711" also works if you don't want to record
the photographer; attribution then shows as Unknown.
Macaulay's search API is behind a proof-of-work bot wall, so asset IDs
cannot be resolved automatically — only the asset CDN is reachable.
